overview: The paper proposes PoLi-RL, a two-stage point-to-list reinforcement learning framework with a Parallel Slice Ranking Reward (PSRR) mechanism, to optimize an LLM-based cross-encoder for Conditional Semantic Textual Similarity (C-STS) by progressively training from pointwise objectives to fine-grained listwise ranking rewards.

modules.name: Data Loading and Pairing
modules.description: Parses the C-STS dataset and processes its unique paired structure, where adjacent samples share the same text segments but differ in conditions and maintain strict ordinal label relationships, preparing them for batch processing.

modules.name: Prompt Construction
modules.description: Constructs the unified few-shot prompt template required for the C-STS task, integrating instructions, few-shot demonstrations, and the query input consisting of text pairs and conditions.

modules.name: Output Parsing and Formatting
modules.description: Extracts the binary judgment and the fine-grained integer score from the LLM's generated sequence, handling format constraints and parsing errors to map outputs to the target label space.

modules.name: Stage I Reward Functions
modules.description: Implements the foundational reward components for the first curriculum stage, including pointwise accuracy reward, binary judgment reward, and format adherence reward.

modules.name: Parallel Slice Construction (PSRR Preprocessing)
modules.description: Implements the Parallel Slice Ranking Reward data restructuring mechanism, organizing a batch of samples with multiple completions each into parallel slices based on completion indices to enable granular credit assignment.

modules.name: Stage II Reward Functions
modules.description: Implements the fine-grained ranking rewards for the second stage, including the pairwise ranking reward leveraging sample ordinality and the listwise ranking reward comparing predicted rank versus ground-truth rank within parallel slices.

modules.name: DAPO Algorithm Core
modules.description: Implements the Decoupled Clip and Dynamic Sampling Policy Optimization algorithm, including Z-score normalized advantage calculation for group completions and the clipped objective function for policy updates.

modules.name: Two-Stage Training Pipeline
modules.description: Orchestrates the two-stage curriculum training workflow, managing the transition from foundational skill acquisition to fine-grained semantic distinction, and implementing gradient accumulation to handle the large batch sizes required for stable ranking signals.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics
modules.description: Computes the core evaluation metrics for the C-STS task, specifically the rank-based correlation coefficients between the predicted scores and ground-truth labels.

modules.name: Ablation and Sensitivity Framework
modules.description: Configures and executes controlled ablation experiments to validate the effectiveness of the two-stage curriculum and individual reward components, as well as sensitivity analyses on reward weights, parallel slice sizes, generation multiplicities, and base reward constants.

modules.name: Cross-Domain Generalization
modules.description: Adapts and evaluates the core framework on multilingual translation quality estimation tasks, excluding task-specific rewards to validate the generalizability of the PSRR mechanism across domains and continuous label scales.

modules.name: Visualization and Reporting
modules.description: Generates experimental analytics including absolute prediction error distribution plots and qualitative case studies comparing the reasoning processes of different baseline models against the proposed framework.

modules.name: Infrastructure and Configuration
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations, training logging, and model checkpoint persistence, ensuring reproducible and scalable reinforcement learning runs.
